# netbox_custom_link (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
// Get a custom link by name
data "netbox_custom_link" "by_name" {
  name = "device-docs"
}

// Get a custom link by ID
data "netbox_custom_link" "by_id" {
  id = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) At least one of `id` or `name` must be given.
- `name` (String) At least one of `id` or `name` must be given.

### Read-Only

- `button_class` (String)
- `content_types` (Set of String)
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `group_name` (String)
- `link_text` (String)
- `link_url` (String)
- `new_window` (Boolean)
- `weight` (Number)
